pages.text: Find a Bee Nest or crafted Beehive in the Overworld. Throw an Ender Pearl directly at it to enter the Bumblezone. Bring equipment and food; the world inside is much stranger than an ordinary bee colony.

To leave, descend below Y=0 or rise above Y=256. The mod tries to return you to where you entered. Look for its honey structures, bee creatures and unusual items, and be careful how you treat the hive.
Some Bumblezone pollen and honey materials also have optional RIFT//STAR uses. Check Field Notes and JEI rather than assuming they exist only for bee-related recipes.
